author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Tindie recently listed Comu, a compact development board built around the WCH CH32V203 RISC-V microcontroller. Measuring 13 × 9.4mm, the board fits inside a USB-A port and combines programmable touch controls, LEDs, USB device support, and access to several GPIO signals. title: Comu Fits a 144MHz CH32V203 RISC-V Board Inside a USB-A Port

author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Raspberry Pi introduced a new 3GB version of the Raspberry Pi 4 Model B in April, positioning it between the existing 2GB and 4GB configurations.
